description: Returns the words that keep company with a Hebrew or Greek word: those that appear in the same verse more often than chance predicts (log-likelihood), strongest first, 15 by default (limit 1-25). Pass strongs (H430) or a word ('shepherd'). Pass with=<Strong's id> to read the verses where two words meet. corpus: he, nt or lxx. Use when the user asks which words commonly appear alongside a given Hebrew or Greek word.

corpus.description: he (Hebrew Bible), nt (Greek New Covenant, also called the New Testament) or lxx (Septuagint)

limit.description: how many results to return (1-25, default 15)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

with.description: a second Strong's id, to see the verses with both

name: get_collocations
title: Words that keep company
